title: Google AI Two Pillars Shake on the Same Day: Jeff Dean Leaves for Entrepreneurship, Gemini Changes Leadership During a Critical Period

content_html:
Google AI has experienced a rare personnel upheaval. Demis Hassabis, head of DeepMind, announced he would step down from daily management duties and take on the role of Chairman of DeepMind and Chief Scientist at Alphabet; almost simultaneously, Google's Chief Scientist Jeff Dean announced the end of his nearly 27-year career at Google, and he and three senior researchers co-founded a new company called Discovery Loop. After the announcement, Alphabet's stock price fell nearly 4% in one day.

Hassabis moves internally, Gemini 4 continues to progress

Hassabis has not left the company but transitioned from an organizational manager to a long-term strategist and chief science advisor. He said that his new position will allow him to focus more on AGI, breakthroughs in basic science, and global AI governance, while continuing to participate in AI drug development work at Isomorphic Labs. Daily management of DeepMind will be taken over by current CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu, who has worked with Hassabis for over 13 years and was involved in projects such as WaveNet and DQN. The development of the Gemini model, cutting-edge AI research, and related teams are now under his management. Hassabis revealed in a public letter that the next-generation model Gemini 4 is progressing well.

Jeff Dean brings half of AI history, Google invests in the new company

Compared to Hassabis's "internal transfer," Jeff Dean's departure caused greater shock. Dean joined Google in 1999, and over the past two decades, many key technologies at Google have been directly related to him, including early search infrastructure, MapReduce, BigTable, TensorFlow, and TPU. Along with him, three prominent figures also left: distributed systems expert Sanjay Ghemawat, technical lead of Gemini Oriol Vinyals, and early member of Google Brain Quoc Le—four of them have participated in projects including AlphaFold, AlphaStar, AlphaCode, and Gemini.

Discovery Loop's core focus is using AI to automate the scientific research cycle—generating experimental designs, executing analysis, and iterating research directions, allowing a large number of experiments to run in parallel. Dean revealed that he started seriously considering entrepreneurship about five weeks ago, and Pichai arranged multiple meetings to try to retain him. Despite the four leaving collectively, Google still invested in Discovery Loop and signed a cloud computing cooperation agreement. The seed round was led jointly by Khosla Ventures and Radical Ventures.

This personnel earthquake comes against the backdrop of Google AI facing multiple pressures. The flagship model Gemini 3.5 Pro was originally scheduled to be released in June, but it has been postponed multiple times and has not been launched yet; two weeks ago, Google announced an increase in AI capital expenditure without providing a new model release date, causing its stock price to drop about 7%. Previously, the author of the Transformer paper, Noam Shazeer, left Google to join OpenAI, and John Jumper, a core researcher of AlphaFold and Nobel Prize winner in Chemistry, moved to Anthropic. As the birthplace of the Transformer architecture, Google has nurtured some of the most important technological talents in the modern AI era—now some of them are beginning to leave, and Google needs to prove not only that it still has a world-class team, but also whether it can retain these people.

content_html_zh:
谷歌人工智能经历了罕见的人事变动。 DeepMind 负责人 Demis Hassabis 宣布辞去日常管理职务，出任 DeepMind 董事长兼 Alphabet 首席科学家；几乎同时，谷歌首席科学家杰夫·迪恩宣布结束他在谷歌近27年的职业生涯，他和三名高级研究人员共同创立了一家名为Discovery Loop的新公司。 消息公布后，Alphabet 股价一日内下跌近 4%。

哈萨比斯内部动静，Gemini 4继续进步

哈萨比斯并没有离开公司，而是从组织经理转变为长期战略家和首席科学顾问。 他表示，新职位将使他能够更加关注AGI、基础科学突破以及全球AI治理，同时继续参与Isomorphic Labs的AI药物开发工作。 DeepMind 的日常管理将由现任 CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu 接管，他与 Hassabis 合作了超过 13 年，并参与了 WaveNet 和 DQN 等项目。 Gemini模型的开发、前沿的AI研究以及相关团队现在都由他负责管理。 哈萨比斯在公开信中透露，下一代车型Gemini 4进展顺利。

杰夫·迪恩带来一半人工智能历史，谷歌投资新公司

相比哈萨比斯的“内部调动”，杰夫·迪恩的离开引起了更大的震动。 Dean 于 1999 年加入 Google，过去二十年里，Google 的很多关键技术都与他直接相关，包括早期的搜索基础设施、MapReduce、BigTable、TensorFlow 和 TPU。 与他一起离开的还有三位杰出人物：分布式系统专家 Sanjay Ghemawat、Gemini Oriol Vinyals 技术负责人以及 Google Brain Quoc Le 早期成员——其中四人曾参与过 AlphaFold、AlphaStar、AlphaCode 和 Gemini 等项目。

Discovery Loop 的核心重点是利用人工智能实现科学研究周期的自动化——生成实验设计、执行分析和迭代研究方向，从而允许大量实验并行运行。 迪恩透露，他大约五周前开始认真考虑创业，皮查伊安排了多次会议试图留住他。 尽管四人集体离开，谷歌仍然投资了Discovery Loop，并签署了云计算合作协议。 本轮种子轮由 Khosla Ventures 和 Radical Ventures 联合领投。

这次人事地震是在谷歌AI面临多重压力的背景下发生的。 旗舰机型Gemini 3.5 Pro原定6月份发布，但多次推迟至今尚未上市；两周前，谷歌在未提供新机型发布日期的情况下宣布增加AI资本支出，导致其股价下跌约7%。 此前，Transformer 论文作者 Noam Shazeer 离开 Google 加入 OpenAI，AlphaFold 核心研究员、诺贝尔化学奖得主 John Jumper 则转投 Anthropic。 作为 Transformer 架构的发源地，谷歌培养了一些现代 AI 时代最重要的技术人才——现在其中一些人开始离开，谷歌需要证明的不仅是它仍然拥有一支世界一流的团队，而且还需要证明它是否能够留住这些人。
